REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JUNE 14, 2007 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.

5.
Presentations
6.
Consideration of appointments to vacancies on various commissions, boards and committees
7.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
8.
Registers of Demands dated 6/14/2007
9.
Minutes of 5/24/2007
End of Consent Calendar
10.
Public Hearings
10A.
Information, discussion, and consideration to authorize further actions related to a proposed development involving the City of Cerritos,Cerritos Redevelopment Agency and the ABC Unified School District for the construction of an affordable senior housing community for individuals age 55 and older, a senior recreation center, a ±3.78-acre park, and remodel of an existing kitchen/warehouse facility for student lunch preparation located at 16700 Norwalk Boulevard in Cerritos, APN 7012-001-900, and for the construction of an administration building located at 12616 183rd Street in Cerritos, APN 7030-002-902
10B.
Consideration of options regarding the continuation of the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District. A resoution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos, ordering a reassessment within the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, confirming the findings of the Engineer’s Report, providing for improvements to, the maintenance of and the furnishing of electric current and landscaping to the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, and ordering the remittance of assessments from reserves in the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping Fund and other available revenues.
11.
Pending Legal Matters
11A.
A resolution of the Cerritos Dedevelopment Agency authorizing the submittal of a bid in response to Resolution no. 06-31 of the Board of Education of the ABC Unified School District authorizing public lease of its surplus property located at 16700 Norwalk Boulevard in Cerritos
11B.
Consideration of amendments to Cerritos Redevelopment Agency loan agreements. ResolutionS of the Cerritos Public Financing Authority and the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency authorizing and directing execution of two separate first amendments to the 2002 subordinate loan agreements relating to the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project and the Los Coyotes Redevelopment Project, respectively, of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency and providing other matters relating thereto.
12.
Report on Pending Legislation
13.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
14.
Adjournment
